purpose: Visual options for approval before further development; concurrent animation direction supersedes sequential focus.

options.title: A · 蓝玻璃协作园区
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished wide 16:9 high-resolution website hero art-direction mockup for GAAC, Option A: BLUE GLASS COLLABORATION CAMPUS. It must feel like an exquisite miniature architectural model, not a grey clay render, not a flat illustration. Strong tangible depth and intricate but tasteful details suitable as a future Three.js target.

Layout: airy off-white #F6FAFA page, left 38% contains live-type-looking Chinese copy, right 62% contains a beautifully composed three-island world, no enclosing rectangle. Left copy exactly: small "Grand Agentic AI Challenge", large broad Chinese title "智能体大奖赛", medium "用智能体，完成真实企业任务。", compact "可编辑 PPT · 财报分析 · 研究报告", a cyan pill button "了解参赛方式". Very small top-left option caption "A / 蓝玻璃协作园区". Bottom a single restrained horizontal information row: "每队 168 小时" | "2 阶段 · 3 类应用必做" | "团队大奖 1 名 · US$10,000". No invented logos or extra navigation needed.

World: three low porcelain floating islands arranged left rear / right rear / front right with clear space at their center. Wide low sinuous porcelain pavilion roofs, clearly SKY-BLUE FROSTED GLASS facades, thin deep-ink metal columns. Thick cyan glass bridges connect ALL THREE to a CENTRAL EdgePod shared compute facility, positioned visibly at front-center-left of the research island. It is a substantial low circular glass compute pavilion, not an anonymous button: transparent pale-cyan shell cut away at the front reveals FOUR recognisable deep-navy server racks, individual rack trays, tiny restrained cyan indicator lights, vents, cooling fins, cable channels, visible structured floor. A porcelain upper rim bears precise "EdgePod"; a neat HTML-style label directly beneath the hub says "共享算力中心". Keep the hub wholly unobscured.

Left-rear PPT island: 3 wide landscape slide surfaces with distinct title/text/image/chart blocks, edit handles and aligned modular layouts, two modules visibly traveling into place along short clean motion traces. Right-rear finance island: distinct readable grid cells, five saturated icy cyan bar columns with navy feet, thin dark line chart on a blue glass panel, several illuminated table rows. Front-right research island: curved low shelves with cyan/white/navy book spines, realistic open book with layered page thickness, report pages, 3 evidence source cards arriving and thin evidence threads. Small cool-white/cyan trees, steps, handrails, walkway grooves, planter detail establish scale. Labels are understated anchored pill plaques outside the geometry with short precise leader lines: "可编辑 PPT", "财报分析", "研究报告". These and the central label are the only world labels.

All THREE islands must visibly work SIMULTANEOUSLY: PPT modules moving, finance chart growing/drawing, research page turning and source cards arriving in the same moment. A few cyan flow beads travel on all three bridges concurrently; no single selected island, no dimmed inactive islands, no sequential spotlight, no numbered stages. A still keyframe communicates concurrent activity via restrained motion traces, never a storyboard.

Palette very important: visibly luminous sky cyan #8AE6FF and deeper optical cyan-blue in thick glass edges; white porcelain #FFFFFF, ice #E4F5FA, deep navy #102C3A. Approximately 35% of architectural surfaces blue glass, deliberate navy structural accents. Strong material separation and richer blue refractions, balanced exposure, darker contact shadows and ambient occlusion with readable detail. Soft neutral daylight, no bleaching, no grey monochrome. Professional product-render quality. No orange, yellow, gold, purple, pink, green, warm light, robots, brain imagery, neon haze, dense particles, or illegible floating microtext. Perspective 3/4 elevated enough to see every island and central servers. Broad low forms, spacious calm collaboration.

options.title: B · 模块化工作室
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined 16:9 high-resolution website hero concept for GAAC, Option B: MODULAR WORK STUDIOS. This is a tangible premium miniature 3D diorama, visibly colorful in blue/cyan and navy with white porcelain, technically plausible to model with Three.js. Distinct from sinuous architectural pavilions: use crisp rounded rectangular islands, modular workbenches, low glass partitions, beautifully detailed manufactured surfaces and readable exposed mechanisms.

Consistent page layout: background #F6FAFA, left 38% elegant live-type-like website copy, right 62% the island world with no rectangular image background. Small top-left caption "B / 模块化工作室". Left copy exactly: "Grand Agentic AI Challenge", large wide Chinese "智能体大奖赛", then "用智能体，完成真实企业任务。", then "可编辑 PPT · 财报分析 · 研究报告", cyan rounded CTA "了解参赛方式". Bottom restrained single row: "每队 168 小时" | "2 阶段 · 3 类应用必做" | "团队大奖 1 名 · US$10,000". No speculative logos or dense navigation.

World composition: three low, separate rounded porcelain platforms in triangular formation (PPT at back-left, Finance at back-right, Research front-right), connected to a shared central COMPUTE POD with three curved thick sky-blue frosted glass walkways. The hub sits clearly visible in the central gap, foreground-left relative to research. It is an unmistakable horizontal miniature DATA CENTER: a wide rounded rectangular white chassis with a translucent cyan removable upper enclosure, a cutaway front exposing four deep-ink rack columns with many individually modeled server blades, ventilation grilles, copper-free dark metallic cable conduits, blue status bars and tiny cyan running indicators. Show a subtle embossed "EdgePod" on the shell. Under it place a small carefully typeset label "共享算力中心". It must feel like the physical resource serving all three studios, not a tower or a decorative sphere.

PPT studio: open desk-like gallery of 3 large blue-framed horizontal presentation panels, with editable separated image/text/chart modules, alignment guides and small corner handles; pieces arrange simultaneously. Finance studio: precision cyan tabletop with white spreadsheet cells and navy fine rules, clearly growing cyan transparent 3D bars and a navy rising line on a clear upright panel. Research studio: a low archive workbench with cyan storage trays, a rich layered open book with white paper and deep navy cover, white report pages, blue citation tabs and 3 source cards connected by fine evidence lines. Carefully model rounded bevels, small hinges, joints, ribs, glass thickness, recessed seams, miniature steps and railings. Tiny white-cyan trees only where needed. Mix white porcelain platforms with bold BLUE GLASS surfaces and 15% deep-navy mechanical detail for hierarchy. Keep the composition low and broad, avoid tall roofs hiding the work.

Only four understated anchored labels, rendered like crisp HTML overlay chips outside each island with short leaders: "可编辑 PPT", "财报分析", "研究报告", plus central "共享算力中心" and physical EdgePod branding. No noisy micro-labels or legends. Never number the islands or imply alternatives: all three required.

Render a simultaneous working keyframe: presentation modules moving into layout while table rows scan and bar/line graphs form while a research page turns and evidence cards arrive, all AT ONCE. A few visible cyan beads flowing on ALL THREE bridges at once. No inactive/dimmed islands, no single spotlight, no sequence arrows between tasks, no step-by-step storyboard.

Palette #8AE6FF primary with rich cyan depth in glass edges, #FFFFFF porcelain, #E4F5FA ice, #102C3A navy. Noticeably richer color and detail than a white clay model. Soft neutral daylight, crisp readable shadows, ambient occlusion, blue reflections, restrained specular highlights. No overexposure or bleached grey appearance. Professional industrial design render. No warm colors, purple, pink, gold, orange, green foliage, robots, holographic brains, cyberpunk or neon fog. Wide isometric-ish camera, each island and the entire shared compute pod clearly visible.

options.title: C · 环形协作港
options.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE premium high-resolution 16:9 website hero art-direction image for GAAC, Option C: CIRCULAR COLLABORATION HARBOR. A beautiful low-profile architectural miniature in sky-blue glass, white porcelain and deep navy. This option has a distinctive integrated circular connection system, unlike a simple 3-spoke layout.

Page layout consistent with a spacious GAAC desktop hero: very pale #F6FAFA background, left 38% typography, right 62% live-3D-looking world, seamlessly blended background. Small top-left caption "C / 环形协作港". Exact left copy: "Grand Agentic AI Challenge", large wide Chinese "智能体大奖赛", then "用智能体，完成真实企业任务。", then "可编辑 PPT · 财报分析 · 研究报告", cyan pill button "了解参赛方式". Bottom one clean facts row: "每队 168 小时" | "2 阶段 · 3 类应用必做" | "团队大奖 1 名 · US$10,000". No additional marketing paragraphs or speculative logos.

The world is three distinct low porcelain island terraces attached to a broad translucent SKY-CYAN ANNULAR GLASS WALKWAY, around a plainly visible central shared EdgePod compute hub. PPT upper-left, Finance upper-right, Research lower-right; leave lower-left ring segment open so the central compute hub can be seen fully and the ring never feels crowded. The ring is a physical glass bridge with tiny rail posts, inset cyan flow channels and dark-blue structural ribs, NOT a floating hologram. Three short physical branches connect all three task terraces to the same ring and hub. Each island is a required parallel workspace, not a selectable level.

Center: a substantial squat three-lobed server pavilion resting on a white circular plinth, with 3 deep-navy rack banks clearly visible behind blue glass doors, finely detailed server trays, vented panels, small bright cyan running LEDs, dark metal cooling fins, a porcelain cap with precise "EdgePod". Central label, high legibility: "共享算力中心", on an understated anchored plaque below the pod. The hub is the shared compute heart. No anonymous cylinder or button, no science-fiction reactor. Recognizable actual data-center equipment.

PPT terrace: sweeping low porcelain canopy partly open, 3 cyan-edged landscape slides with separate dark title bars, white text regions, blue chart blocks and image modules, alignment handles. Finance terrace: a circular blue-glass analysis desk with precise white table cells, five varied-height cyan 3D bars and delicate navy line chart. Research terrace: fan-shaped low shelves in alternating white/navy/sky-blue, an open layered book, fanned report pages, cyan evidence cards visibly joining the report with very fine connecting threads. Miniature steps, curved benches, rails, blue-glass thickness, small icy-white trees and meaningful surface detail provide human scale without people.

The three outputs are visibly being produced AT THE SAME TIME: presentation modules shift, financial rows illuminate with bars and line completing, research page turns while evidence flows in. Show short restrained motion trails in all three locations. A sparse stream of cyan luminous beads moves continuously around the ring and to all three workplaces concurrently, never a sequence of one active island. No dimmed islands, no spotlight cycling, no numbered stages.

Only minimal crisp HTML-style anchored labels close to their relevant islands: "可编辑 PPT", "财报分析", "研究报告", plus hub label. No floating explanatory text, no legends, no extra tiny labels. Every label must have visual breathing room and not cover geometry.

Palette: saturated visible sky cyan #8AE6FF, icy blue #E4F5FA, WHITE #FFFFFF, deep ink navy #102C3A, slightly deeper cyan caused by thick glass and shadows. At least one-third of the world has visibly blue surfaces and contrast, with a strong dark central hub. Neutral soft daylight, beautiful contact shadows and ambient occlusion, subtle blue reflections, restrained brilliance. No grey washed-out clay render, no overexposure. No orange, gold, yellow, purple, pink, warm lighting, green trees, robot, brain, neon haze or particle storm. Elevated three-quarter camera that clearly separates all three island terraces and central servers. Flat, wide, elegant architectural proportions.
